title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai and re-arrangement of taking up the matters of Hon'ble Court (Coram : Hon'ble Mr. Justice N. S. Sanjay Gowda and Hon'ble Mr. Justice J. L. Odedra) on 23.10.20
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 22/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 23.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 22/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-04/2026
It is hereby notified that on 23.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai would
not be available for Judicial work.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D.
Karia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai) would
take up the matters notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble
Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen
and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai.)
(3) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Mr. Justice
Bhargav D. Karia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S.
Desai) would take up the matters notified in the Cause
list of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice N. S.
Sanjay Gowda and Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. L. Odedra)
(4) Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen would sit
Single and take up the matters at Sr. No. 113 to Sr.
No. 143 notified before Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble
Mr. Justice Aniruddha P. Mayee.)
By Order of Hon’ble Acting The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
